research_question: Can a bounded, PIT-only cross-sector acceleration event improve V3 response to fast style reversals without allowing external information to become an independent buy signal?
prior_evidence_disclosure: Earlier external-context rounds did not establish a robust production candidate. Round75 only extends exits of already-profitable positions and is not a reversal solution. The extended interval has been reused and is diagnostic rather than untouched.

event_definition.standardization: expanding z-score fitted only on prior signal dates

carrier.external_feature: SW2021 L1 sector acceleration relative to the equal-weight SW L1 market
carrier.rank_weights_and_execution: unchanged personal-eligible V3 account replay contract with shadow-baseline instrumentation

selection.one_standard_error_rule: among tuning-and-validation non-degrade survivors with at least three validation events and positive mean validation 10-day incremental return, choose the smallest lambda within one standard error of the best mean validation 10-day incremental return
selection.leave_one_event_out_rule: a positive full-period improvement is concentrated if removing any changed event removes more than 50 percent of that improvement or flips its sign
